_about: Hand-read instrumentation for the pages the score-order prior was measured
on. Every part below was read off a render of the page's LEFT MARGIN, part by
part (Claude, 2026-08-28); the renders are committed beside the Phase-1
baseline evidence. It is not pipeline output, and it is the part of this
`parts` is one canonical instrument name per STAFF, top to bottom — so a
divided violin section contributes several Violin entries, and a harp on two
staves contributes two Harps. That is what the prior has to reproduce.

notes: A German pocket score with no text layer, which is why it is here: before
the prior this page had no instrument identity at all.
The margin reads Fl. Ob. Cl. Fag. Cor. Tr. Tp. — the Tp./Tr. pair the

pages.work: Debussy, La Mer (orchestral score), printed p.168
notes: 21 staves for 17 parts: two horns, a harp on two staves, and both violin
sections divided. The piccolo (Pte Fl.) is printed BELOW the flute, which
is the French convention and not the German one — the two traditions are
what the prior has to tell apart.
The twelfth staff is Cymbales, on a single line.
